content:
Subtracting consecutive equations gives
\[
a_k a_{k+1}=k(k+1).
\]
In particular, \(a_1a_2=2\), so the integer pairs are
\[
(1,2),(2,1),(-1,-2),(-2,-1).
\]
Each pair determines the whole sequence recursively. If \(a_1=c\), then
\[
a_{2m-1}=(2m-1)c,\qquad a_{2m}=\frac{2m}{c}.
\]
For \(c=\pm1,\pm2\), all terms are integers. Thus all four initial pairs yield valid sequences.

\[
\boxed{4}
\]
